import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] C = new long[75][75];
    static final long oo = 0x3f3f3f3fL;
    static final int maxN = 70;
    static final int maxn = 50;
    static final int lim = 22;

    static void prepare() {
        for (int i = 0; i < maxN; i++) {
            C[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                C[i][j] = C[i-1][j-1] + C[i-1][j];
            }
        }
    }

    static int n, m, N, mid;
    static int[] g = new int[maxN + 5];
    static List<long[]>[] partb = new List[maxn + 5][maxn + 5];
    static Map<Long, Long>[] parta = new Map[maxn + 5][maxn + 5];

    static void dfs_partb(int x, int cnta, int cntb, long sum) {
        if (x == mid) {
            partb[cnta][cntb].add(new long[]{sum, 1});
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            if (g[x - 1] != -1 && i != g[x - 1]) continue;
            long tmp = 0;
            if (i == 0) {
                if (cnta > 0) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                        tmp += C[cnta - 1][n - 1] * C[cntb][j] * C[N - x][n - j];
                    }
                    dfs_partb(x - 1, cnta - 1, cntb, sum + tmp);
                }
            } else {
                if (cntb > 0) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                        tmp -= C[cntb - 1][n - 1] * C[cnta][j] * C[N - x][n - j];
                    }
                    dfs_partb(x - 1, cnta, cntb - 1, sum + tmp);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static long ans = Long.MAX_VALUE;
    static long ans_cnt = 0;

    static void update(long val, long cnt) {
        if (val < ans) {
            ans = val;
            ans_cnt = cnt;
        } else if (val == ans) {
            ans_cnt += cnt;
        }
    }

    static void bfs_parta() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m + 1; j++) {
                parta[i][j].clear();
            }
        }
        parta[0][0].put(0L, 1L);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m + 1; j++) {
                for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : parta[i][j].entrySet()) {
                    long u_x = entry.getKey();
                    long u_y = entry.getValue();
                    
                    if (i + j == mid) {
                        List<long[]> list = partb[i][j];
                        int p = lowerBound(list, -u_x);
                        if (p < list.size()) {
                            update(Math.abs(u_x + list.get(p)[0]), u_y * list.get(p)[1]);
                        }
                        if (p > 0) {
                            update(Math.abs(u_x + list.get(p - 1)[0]), u_y * list.get(p - 1)[1]);
                        }
                    } else {
                        int p = i + j;
                        for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
                            if (g[p] != -1 && k != g[p]) continue;
                            int cnta = i, cntb = j;
                            if (k == 0) cnta++;
                            else cntb++;
                            
                            if (cnta <= n + m && cntb <= n + m) {
                                long tmp = 0;
                                if (k == 0) {
                                    for (int l = 0; l < n; l++) {
                                        tmp += C[cnta - 1][n - 1] * C[cntb][l] * C[N - p - 1][n - l];
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    for (int l = 0; l < n; l++) {
                                        tmp -= C[cntb - 1][n - 1] * C[cnta][l] * C[N - p - 1][n - l];
                                    }
                                }
                                parta[cnta][cntb].put(u_x + tmp, parta[cnta][cntb].getOrDefault(u_x + tmp, 0L) + u_y);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void work() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m + 1; j++) {
                partb[i][j].clear();
            }
        }
        dfs_partb(N, n + m, n + m, 0);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m + 1; j++) {
                List<long[]> list = partb[i][j];
                Collections.sort(list, (a, b) -> Long.compare(a[0], b[0]));
                List<long[]> tmp = new ArrayList<>();
                int sz = list.size();
                for (int k = 0; k < sz; ) {
                    long cur = list.get(k)[0];
                    int cnt = 0;
                    while (k < sz && list.get(k)[0] == cur) {
                        cnt += list.get(k)[1];
                        k++;
                    }
                    tmp.add(new long[]{cur, cnt});
                }
                partb[i][j] = tmp;
            }
        }
        bfs_parta();
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<long[]> list, long target) {
        int left = 0, right = list.size();
        while (left < right) {
            int mid = (left + right) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid)[0] >= target) {
                right = mid;
            } else {
                left = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return left;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        prepare();
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        m = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        String s = br.readLine();
        
        N = (n + m) << 1;
        mid = Math.max(0, N - lim);
        Arrays.fill(g, -1);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m + 1; j++) {
                partb[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
                parta[i][j] = new HashMap<>();
            }
        }
        
        ans = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        ans_cnt = 0;
        work();
        
        Arrays.fill(g, -1);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            if (s.charAt(i) == 'A') g[i] = 0;
            else if (s.charAt(i) == 'B') g[i] = 1;
        }
        
        ans = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        ans_cnt = 0;
        work();
        
        System.out.println(ans_cnt);
    }
}
